expressions.cn: 禁止校园兄弟会与姐妹会体系或相关活动
expressions.source_excerpt: Even Cornell University, a lot of students are trying to ban Greek life.
expressions.example: The debate asked whether the college should ban Greek life.
expressions.example_cn: 辩论讨论了学校是否应该禁止兄弟会与姐妹会体系。
expressions.context_review_note: Greek life is campus organizations, not Greek culture generally. Source describes students' advocacy, not an enacted ban.

expressions.definition: gain substantial help or advantage from something
expressions.source_excerpt: Colleges and universities, they benefit a lot from fraternities.
expressions.example: New staff benefit a lot from regular feedback.
expressions.example_cn: 新员工从定期反馈中获益很多。
expressions.context_review_note: Benefit from + noun or -ing. Source's institutional benefits are the narrator's argument, not quantified proof of net value.

expressions.definition: a financial motive tied to the final profit or cost outcome
expressions.source_excerpt: And also on top of that, there is a bottom line incentive.
expressions.example: Reducing waste creates a bottom-line incentive for the business.
expressions.example_cn: 减少浪费能给企业带来经济利益方面的动力。
expressions.context_review_note: Bottom line is financial outcome, not the literal last line on a page. Hyphenate bottom-line before a noun in edited writing; source spelling is preserved.

expressions.definition: promotion that occurs as an inherent part of an existing arrangement
expressions.source_excerpt: It's kind of like built-in marketing.
expressions.example: The visible logo provides built-in marketing for the brand.
expressions.example_cn: 醒目的标志为品牌自带宣传效果。
expressions.context_review_note: Built-in is metaphorical integration, not necessarily a physical installation. Source analogy does not establish measured advertising value.

expressions.definition: are not required or do not need to do something
expressions.source_excerpt: One random one that I hadn't even thought of was a lot of these universities, they don't have to build and maintain more buildings anymore.
expressions.example: You don't have to print the document.
expressions.example_cn: 你不必打印这份文件。
expressions.context_review_note: Absence of necessity, not prohibition: don't have to is different from must not. Source discusses an asserted reduction in building needs.

expressions.definition: helpful in terms of money or finances
expressions.source_excerpt: It's deeply financially beneficial for a lot of these institutions.
expressions.example: Sharing equipment can be financially beneficial for a small team.
expressions.example_cn: 共享设备对小团队来说可能在经济上更有利。
expressions.context_review_note: Financially limits beneficial to money; it does not imply the arrangement is beneficial in every respect.

expressions.definition: obtaining money borrowed to pay for education
expressions.source_excerpt: That is more enticing to someone than getting student loans for whatever degree that they want.
expressions.example: She compared the costs before getting student loans.
expressions.example_cn: 她在申请助学贷款之前比较了费用。
expressions.context_review_note: Loans are borrowed funds, not scholarships or free money. The sentence is a language example, not a recommendation to borrow.

expressions.definition: more attractive or tempting to a particular person
expressions.source_excerpt: That is more enticing to someone than getting student loans for whatever degree that they want.
expressions.example: A shorter commute is more enticing to me than a larger office.
expressions.example_cn: 比起更大的办公室，更短的通勤对我更有吸引力。
expressions.context_review_note: Enticing to + person; than introduces the comparison. Source describes a perceived appeal, not what every student values.

expressions.definition: in addition to the point already mentioned
expressions.source_excerpt: And also on top of that, there is a bottom line incentive.
expressions.example: The room is spacious. On top of that, it's quiet.
expressions.example_cn: 房间很宽敞，而且还很安静。
expressions.context_review_note: Adds another benefit or problem; not a physical stacking instruction in this discourse use.

expressions.definition: one out of each group of eight, as a proportion
expressions.source_excerpt: Because when you have all these sororities and fraternities, like some colleges, one in every eight students lives in a Greek life house.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: In this sample, one in every eight responses was incomplete.
expressions.example_cn: 在这个样本中，每八份回复就有一份不完整。
expressions.context_review_note: Equivalent proportion to one in eight; not every eighth person in a literal sequence. Source attributes the housing figure to some colleges, not all institutions.

expressions.definition: the appealing prospect or expectation of something
expressions.source_excerpt: The promise of being able to defy gravity and do a keg stand on a random Thursday night.
expressions.example: The promise of more free time made the shorter commute appealing.
expressions.example_cn: 能有更多空闲时间的前景，让更短的通勤显得很有吸引力。
expressions.context_review_note: Here an appealing prospect, not necessarily a binding spoken promise. The source's risky example is not reproduced as an instruction.

expressions.definition: the people or organizations mentioned do not need to do something
expressions.source_excerpt: One random one that I hadn't even thought of was a lot of these universities, they don't have to build and maintain more buildings anymore.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: They don't have to attend every session.
expressions.example_cn: 他们不必参加每一场活动。
expressions.context_review_note: They requires a clear antecedent; in source it resumes universities after a spoken topic shift. Not a ban on attendance or construction.

expressions.definition: as stated or reported by a specified source
expressions.source_excerpt: But also alumni who are part of Greek life seem to, at least according to one research done, seem more financially generous to their alma maters later in life if they were part of Greek life.
expressions.example: According to the report, attendance increased.
expressions.example_cn: 根据报告，出席人数增加了。
expressions.context_review_note: Attributes information rather than proving it. The source has awkward one research wording; use one study in neutral teaching prose without changing the quote.

expressions.definition: limiting a claim to what a named source reports
expressions.source_excerpt: But also alumni who are part of Greek life seem to, at least according to one research done, seem more financially generous to their alma maters later in life if they were part of Greek life.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The project is on schedule, at least according to the latest update.
expressions.example_cn: 项目按计划进行，至少最新进展说明是这么说的。
expressions.context_review_note: At least restricts the basis for the statement rather than counting sources. A single report is not independent confirmation.

expressions.definition: is destroyed or severely damaged by fire
expressions.source_excerpt: Because yeah, you want to make sure that everything is covered if there's a fire and the building is insured if it burns down.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The novel begins after the old house burns down.
expressions.example_cn: 小说从那座老房子被烧毁后开始。
expressions.context_review_note: Intransitive burn down describes destruction; burn a building down is transitive. The fictional teaching example does not describe a podcast event.

expressions.definition: calculated per bed and per student in the speaker's description
expressions.cn: 按床位、按学生人数计算
expressions.source_excerpt: So that means less buildings, less insurance the school has to pay for those student dorms because it's like by bed and by student.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The hypothetical budget is broken down by bed and by student.
expressions.example_cn: 这份假设预算按床位和学生人数分别列出。
expressions.context_review_note: By signals the unit or basis of calculation; source's claim about insurance pricing is not verified as a universal method.

expressions.definition: increase how many there are
expressions.source_excerpt: It also allows institutions to expand the number of students they can admit, which means more tuition.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The team plans to expand the number of available sessions.
expressions.example_cn: 团队计划增加可参加的场次。
expressions.context_review_note: Expand the number of + plural noun; increase the number is also natural. Source discusses admissions capacity as an argued consequence.

expressions.definition: possibly even the oldest, after asserting membership among the oldest
expressions.source_excerpt: Chi Phi is one of the oldest, if not the oldest American fraternity.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: It is one of the oldest buildings here, if not the oldest.
expressions.example_cn: 它是这里最古老的建筑之一，甚至可能是最古老的。
expressions.context_review_note: Rhetorical strengthening with uncertainty, not the ordinary if something is not condition. Do not turn the source's hedge into a verified historical superlative.

expressions.definition: combined separate entities into a single entity
expressions.source_excerpt: Apparently, it was three separate organizations that merged into one.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The three folders were merged into one.
expressions.example_cn: 三个文件夹被合并成了一个。
expressions.context_review_note: Merge into emphasizes the resulting single entity; source begins apparently, preserving uncertainty about the historical account.

expressions.definition: within the university's grounds or campus setting
expressions.source_excerpt: Is it worth it to keep fraternities on campus when they appear to be quite dangerous?
expressions.example: She works on campus three days a week.
expressions.example_cn: 她每周有三天在校园里工作。
expressions.context_review_note: Usually no article in on campus. Source asks about retaining organizations there, rather than stating that a ban occurred.

expressions.definition: appear more willing to give money
expressions.cn: 似乎在金钱捐助方面更慷慨
expressions.source_excerpt: But also alumni who are part of Greek life seem to, at least according to one research done, seem more financially generous to their alma maters later in life if they were part of Greek life.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: In the survey, returning donors seem more financially generous than first-time donors.
expressions.example_cn: 在这项调查中，重复捐助者似乎比首次捐助者在捐款方面更慷慨。
expressions.context_review_note: Seem is an evidentiary hedge and more requires a comparison; financial generosity does not describe kindness in all domains.

expressions.definition: lose footing because of a surface or substance
expressions.source_excerpt: But also if someone walks into the building and they slip on a puddle of water, they might sue the school.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: He slipped on a wet tile.
expressions.example_cn: 他踩到湿瓷砖滑了一下。
expressions.context_review_note: Slipping because of a surface here, not slip on a jacket meaning put it on quickly. The presence of water does not itself settle liability.

expressions.definition: valuable enough to justify the effort, cost or risk
expressions.cn: 值得；值得付出这些代价
expressions.source_excerpt: But I guess the question that's been coming up more recently is, is it really fucking worth it?
expressions.example: The journey was tiring, but it was worth it.
expressions.example_cn: 旅途很累，但值得。
expressions.context_review_note: It refers to the implied cost or effort. Source asks a value question and uses profanity for emphasis, not as part of the core phrase.

expressions.definition: existed or been present for some time
expressions.source_excerpt: It's been around.
expressions.example: That shop has been around for decades.
expressions.example_cn: 那家店已经开了几十年。
expressions.context_review_note: Be around can mean be nearby, but here it concerns longevity; the previous founding date provides the time context.

expressions.definition: has existed or remained in that place from a starting time until the reference time
expressions.source_excerpt: The Xi chapter has been there since 1891.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The library has been there since 1985.
expressions.example_cn: 那座图书馆自1985年以来一直在那里。
expressions.context_review_note: Since introduces a starting point, not a duration; contrast for many years. Teaching date is invented for the example, not a correction of the source date.

expressions.definition: very close to a major transition, often with a sense of risk
expressions.cn: 处于……的边缘；即将进入……阶段
expressions.source_excerpt: They're all on the precipice of becoming a.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The company was on the precipice of a major change.
expressions.example_cn: 公司即将迎来一次重大变化。
expressions.context_review_note: Figurative cliff-edge image with of + noun/-ing. Source trails off at becoming a and continues in 340; do not treat 339 as a complete model sentence.

expressions.definition: the night associated with a specified date or event
expressions.source_excerpt: And I guess they're all like on the this is the night of the initiation.
expressions.example: We stayed nearby the night of the concert.
expressions.example_cn: 演唱会那晚我们住在附近。
expressions.context_review_note: Of introduces the event or date, not duration. Source links the night to initiation, without providing a new timestamp.

expressions.definition: across many parts or the whole surface of something
expressions.source_excerpt: Hands reached under the waistband of my basketball shorts and slathered fistfuls of spicy mung all over my genitals.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: There were sticky notes all over the desk.
expressions.example_cn: 桌子上到处都是便签。
expressions.context_review_note: Distribution sense here, not all over meaning finished. Neutral teaching example is separate from the quoted allegation.

expressions.definition: as was discovered later
expressions.source_excerpt: And pressured to solve a riddle that, as it turned out, had no actual answer.
expressions.example: As it turned out, the spare key was in my bag.
expressions.example_cn: 后来发现，备用钥匙就在我的包里。
expressions.context_review_note: Introduces hindsight, often contrary to expectation. Source reveals the reported riddle had no answer.

expressions.definition: on an occasion when something had never happened before
expressions.source_excerpt: And there, for the first time in my life, I was essayed.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: She spoke at a conference for the first time.
expressions.example_cn: 她第一次在会议上发言。
expressions.context_review_note: Use for with first-time occurrence. Reviewing the time phrase does not resolve the nonstandard essayed in the source.

expressions.definition: no real or valid solution
expressions.source_excerpt: And pressured to solve a riddle that, as it turned out, had no actual answer.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The trick question had no actual answer.
expressions.example_cn: 那个捉弄人的问题没有真正的答案。
expressions.context_review_note: Actual means real, not current. Source asserts the riddle lacked a solution; it does not mean the person merely failed to solve it.

expressions.definition: has been closed or stopped from operating
expressions.cn: 已经被关闭或停止运作
expressions.source_excerpt: So this house that everybody's talking about now with the Jane Doe case has been shut down since 2024.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The old booking service has been shut down.
expressions.example_cn: 旧的预订服务已经停止运作。
expressions.context_review_note: Present-perfect passive, describing a closure relevant at the reference time. Narrated since 2024 is not independently checked as a current status.

expressions.definition: close or stop operating an organization, service or system
expressions.source_excerpt: So this house that everybody's talking about now with the Jane Doe case has been shut down since 2024.
expressions.example: They shut down the service for maintenance.
expressions.example_cn: 他们关闭服务进行维护。
expressions.context_review_note: Can be transitive or intransitive; with a pronoun use shut it down. Does not necessarily mean a building was demolished.

expressions.definition: valuable enough to spend time reading
expressions.source_excerpt: It's worth reading.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The guide is short and worth reading.
expressions.example_cn: 这份指南简短，值得一读。
expressions.context_review_note: Worth takes -ing, not to read. Source recommendation does not certify the text as unbiased or error-free.

expressions.definition: read or examine material carefully
expressions.source_excerpt: When you go through little snippets of the Title IX investigation, which is the Jane Doe investigation that we're going to kind of get into in a second, there are allegations that someone overdosed.
expressions.example: Let's go through the notes before the meeting.
expressions.example_cn: 开会前，我们逐一看一下笔记吧。
expressions.context_review_note: Different from Unit 4's experience-a-process sense. Source means examine snippets, not necessarily review the complete underlying investigation.

expressions.definition: having or holding something
expressions.source_excerpt: So we don't know if it was the same individual, if it was two different individuals, if someone is supplying and then someone overdosed or if someone overdosed and that's how they found out that they were in possession of ketamine.
expressions.example: She was in possession of the original receipt.
expressions.example_cn: 她持有原始收据。
expressions.context_review_note: Formal possession phrase; holding an item does not by itself identify its source or establish all surrounding acts. Source expressly lists uncertain alternatives.

expressions.definition: outside the university's campus grounds
expressions.source_excerpt: So it's not off campus housing, which means it's technically under the jurisdiction of Cornell, right?
expressions.example: Many students live off campus.
expressions.example_cn: 许多学生住在校外。
expressions.context_review_note: Use off-campus before a noun in edited writing. Source negates off campus and infers jurisdiction; location alone does not prove every legal or institutional power.

expressions.definition: within the authority or responsibility of an institution or body
expressions.source_excerpt: So it's not off campus housing, which means it's technically under the jurisdiction of Cornell, right?
expressions.example: The notice says the facility is under the jurisdiction of the city.
expressions.example_cn: 通知称，该设施在市政府管辖范围内。
expressions.context_review_note: A formal authority phrase. This gloss does not verify the narrator's conclusion about Cornell's jurisdiction or eliminate possible overlapping authority.

expressions.definition: we lack certainty about whether something is true
expressions.source_excerpt: So we don't know if it was the same individual, if it was two different individuals, if someone is supplying and then someone overdosed or if someone overdosed and that's how they found out that they were in possession of ketamine.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: We don't know if the two reports describe the same event.
expressions.example_cn: 我们不知道两份报告描述的是否是同一件事。
expressions.context_review_note: If means whether in an embedded question. Source's alternative accounts must remain alternatives, not a synthesized factual timeline.

expressions.definition: inside the premises used by a local fraternity or sorority group
expressions.source_excerpt: They have a creed of Kai-Fai and it reads in short, I believe in the friendship of Kai-Fai, whether on the road or in the chapter house, the hand of brotherhood is always extended.
expressions.example: The members held a meeting in the chapter house.
expressions.example_cn: 成员们在分会会所里开了会。
expressions.context_review_note: Chapter is a local organizational branch, not a book section. Source pairs this with on the road as a rhetorical wherever-members-are contrast.

expressions.definition: for approximately a two-year duration
expressions.source_excerpt: So she's already been there for about two years.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: She has worked here for about two years.
expressions.example_cn: 她在这里工作了大约两年。
expressions.context_review_note: For introduces duration, about makes it approximate, and has been there in source connects it to the narrated point rather than today's date.

expressions.definition: discuss all the material just mentioned in more detail
expressions.cn: 详细谈谈刚才提到的全部内容
expressions.source_excerpt: We're going to get into all of it.
expressions.example: We'll get into all of it after a short overview.
expressions.example_cn: 简要概述之后，我们会详细谈到这些内容。
expressions.context_review_note: Discuss sense, not physically enter. All of it refers to the announced material, not every possible fact about the case.

expressions.definition: a setting regarded as protected from harm or danger
expressions.source_excerpt: They were just, they made it seem like, oh, this is where you network and you make so many friends and it seems like a safe environment.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The organizers want to provide a safe environment for discussion.
expressions.example_cn: 组织者希望提供一个安全的讨论环境。
expressions.context_review_note: Source says seems like and made it seem like, describing an impression; do not turn it into a guarantee of safety.

expressions.definition: bring legal action against one named party and additional parties
expressions.source_excerpt: But in September of 2026, Jane Doe decides that she's going to sue not just Cornell, but her sorority, the Chi Phi fraternity, as well as seven members of Chi Phi, as well as another bar.
expressions.example: In the fictional example, they sue not just the seller but also the distributor.
expressions.example_cn: 在这个虚构例子中，他们起诉的不只是卖家，还有经销商。
expressions.context_review_note: Incomplete not just A but B frame; preserve the list structure. Naming defendants does not establish their liability.

expressions.definition: what was happening at the relevant time
expressions.cn: 当时发生了什么；当时是什么情况
expressions.source_excerpt: But unless you were a student there, unless you knew what was going on, I mean, nobody was really talking about it.
expressions.example: I asked a colleague what was going on.
expressions.example_cn: 我问同事当时是什么情况。
expressions.context_review_note: Embedded question uses statement word order. Source discusses awareness, not an independent account of every event.

expressions.definition: an informal hedge or approximate comparison
expressions.cn: 有点像；大概算是（口语弱化表达）
expressions.source_excerpt: Now, the university does not place the fraternity on some sort of like interim suspension because they're going to host another party that day.
expressions.example: The workshop felt sort of like a group problem-solving session.
expressions.example_cn: 那次工作坊感觉有点像一次集体解决问题的讨论。
expressions.context_review_note: Source combines some sort of with filler like before interim suspension; do not force the whole sequence into a clean comparison or formal written model.

expressions.definition: involved in the fraternity and sorority system
expressions.cn: 属于或参与校园兄弟会与姐妹会体系
expressions.source_excerpt: But also alumni who are part of Greek life seem to, at least according to one research done, seem more financially generous to their alma maters later in life if they were part of Greek life.
expressions.example: She was part of Greek life while at college.
expressions.example_cn: 她上大学时参加了校园姐妹会体系的活动。
expressions.context_review_note: Institutional participation, not Greek nationality or language study. Source's donation comparison does not prove causation.

expressions.definition: during his first year at a school or college
expressions.source_excerpt: OK, and he says that when he was a freshman, he had endured months of physical, emotional and psychological damage.
expressions.example: He joined the club when he was a freshman.
expressions.example_cn: 他还是一年级学生时就加入了那个社团。
expressions.context_review_note: Freshman is a first-year student in this college context, not a new employee generally. Teaching example is not a source quotation.

expressions.definition: had suffered or put up with something for several months before a later past point
expressions.source_excerpt: OK, and he says that when he was a freshman, he had endured months of physical, emotional and psychological damage.
expressions.example: They had endured months of disruption before the repairs ended.
expressions.example_cn: 维修结束之前，他们已经忍受了数月的干扰。
expressions.context_review_note: Past perfect locates the suffering before the narrated moment; months of introduces duration plus a noun describing what was endured.

expressions.definition: with body weight supported on the elbows and knees
expressions.cn: 用我的手肘和膝盖支撑着身体
expressions.source_excerpt: Then i was blindfolded again made to crawl on my elbows and knees on hard wooden floors
expressions.example: I was on my elbows and knees looking under the sofa.
expressions.example_cn: 我用手肘和膝盖撑着身体，往沙发下面看。
expressions.context_review_note: A posture phrase, not an instruction to reproduce the alleged forced action. Possessive pronouns change with the speaker.

expressions.definition: not able to express an idea or feeling clearly in words
expressions.source_excerpt: But inside, I was ashamed of my vulnerability and unable to articulate or process the pain I was in.
expressions.example: She felt upset but was unable to articulate why.
expressions.example_cn: 她感到难过，却说不清为什么。
expressions.context_review_note: Articulate means put into words here, not move a mechanical joint. Lack of words does not mean lack of distress.

expressions.definition: a temporary suspension while a further decision or process is pending
expressions.cn: 临时停权或停学；等待后续决定期间的暂停资格
expressions.source_excerpt: Now, the university does not place the fraternity on some sort of like interim suspension because they're going to host another party that day.
expressions.example: The notice describes the suspension as an interim measure.
expressions.example_cn: 通知将此次暂停资格描述为临时措施。
expressions.context_review_note: Interim is pending further action, not necessarily a final punishment. Specific institutional powers or findings are not established by the term alone.

expressions.definition: took someone into custody under legal authority
expressions.source_excerpt: We made an arrest at your house.
expressions.example: The report says officers made an arrest later that day.
expressions.example_cn: 报告称，警员在当天晚些时候实施了逮捕。
expressions.context_review_note: Make an arrest is a common collocation; arrest is not conviction. Source is an imagined paraphrase addressed to the house, not a newly verified police quotation.

expressions.definition: honesty and consistency in following one's moral principles
expressions.source_excerpt: Their founding principles they state are truth, honor, and personal integrity.
expressions.example: The role requires sound judgment and personal integrity.
expressions.example_cn: 这个职位要求良好的判断力和正直的品格。
expressions.context_review_note: Integrity concerns ethical character here, not technical data integrity. Source quotes stated values without proving adherence to them.

expressions.definition: becomes widely exposed or develops dramatically
expressions.source_excerpt: But this is when the entire case breaks open and she starts sharing the relevant details.
expressions.example: The fictional case breaks open when a new witness comes forward.
expressions.example_cn: 在这个虚构案件中，一名新证人出面后，案情有了重大进展。
expressions.context_review_note: Figurative opening of a case to public attention or new information; not necessarily solved, adjudicated or physically broken.

expressions.definition: information directly connected to the topic being discussed
expressions.source_excerpt: 20 year old Jane Doe, this is obviously a pseudonym, but Jane Doe shares the relevant details of her starting at Cornell in her civil lawsuit.
expressions.example: Please include only the relevant details in the summary.
expressions.example_cn: 请只在摘要中写入相关细节。
expressions.context_review_note: Relevant means pertinent, not automatically true or complete. Source attributes details to a plaintiff's account.

expressions.definition: form friendships with a large number of people
expressions.source_excerpt: They were just, they made it seem like, oh, this is where you network and you make so many friends and it seems like a safe environment.
expressions.example: She didn't expect to make so many friends in the class.
expressions.example_cn: 她没想到能在班里交到这么多朋友。
expressions.context_review_note: Make friends with someone, not manufacture friends. Source reports a promised social benefit rather than guaranteeing it.

expressions.definition: several years before the relevant present time
expressions.source_excerpt: Now, Jared Hoffman was a Chi Phi pledge at the Cornell chapter years ago.
expressions.example: I visited that town years ago.
expressions.example_cn: 我多年前去过那个小城。
expressions.context_review_note: Ago normally accompanies past tense and is relative to the speaker's time. Do not replace the recording-relative date with today's date.

expressions.definition: according to what her lawsuit states
expressions.source_excerpt: She's not of legal drinking age, but she's completely intoxicated as per her lawsuit, she alleges.
expressions.example: As per the written request, we sent a copy by email.
expressions.example_cn: 按照书面请求，我们通过电子邮件发送了一份副本。
expressions.context_review_note: As per is formal and often bureaucratic; according to is more natural in everyday speech. Source attributes the claim to the filing, not to this reviewer.

expressions.definition: understand or find a solution to something
expressions.source_excerpt: This is another undergraduate student who's also just trying to figure out college.
expressions.example: I'm trying to figure out why the printer stopped.
expressions.example_cn: 我正想弄明白打印机为什么停了。
expressions.context_review_note: Separable with pronouns: figure it out. Here it is about understanding college life, not numerical calculation.

expressions.definition: the minimum age at which drinking alcohol is legally permitted in the relevant setting
expressions.source_excerpt: She's not of legal drinking age, but she's completely intoxicated as per her lawsuit, she alleges.
expressions.example: The sign asks visitors to confirm that they are of legal drinking age.
expressions.example_cn: 标牌要求来访者确认自己已达到法定饮酒年龄。
expressions.context_review_note: Of legal drinking age is the natural eligibility phrase. No jurisdiction-wide age rule or exception is asserted by this language example.

expressions.definition: leave the university campus grounds
expressions.source_excerpt: She gets in the Subaru and they go off campus to a bar called Mooney's.
expressions.example: We often go off campus for lunch.
expressions.example_cn: 我们经常去校外吃午饭。
expressions.context_review_note: Go off campus is movement outside campus, not leaving university permanently. The source's Subaru/Uber wording remains separately flagged.

expressions.definition: not connected or affiliated with a person or organization
expressions.source_excerpt: Okay, so they're not associated with the school.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The club is not associated with the company.
expressions.example_cn: 这个俱乐部与那家公司没有隶属或关联关系。
expressions.context_review_note: Associated with describes a relationship; source may be distinguishing school affiliation from employment, so it should not be generalized into no connection of any kind.

expressions.definition: not people who belonged to the group in the past, despite that possibility being expected
expressions.cn: 甚至连以前的成员也不是
expressions.source_excerpt: Sometimes they're not even former members of the sorority or fraternity.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: Some advisers are not even former members of the club.
expressions.example_cn: 有些顾问甚至连该俱乐部以前的成员也不是。
expressions.context_review_note: Even emphasizes the surprising absence of a prior-membership link. Source says sometimes, not that every employee has this background.

expressions.definition: at approximately ten o'clock at night
expressions.source_excerpt: Then around 10 p.m., Jane Doe and a few of her sorority sisters, they walk over to a separate bar called Lot 10.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: We expect to arrive around 10 p.m.
expressions.example_cn: 我们预计晚上十点左右到达。
expressions.context_review_note: Around is approximate, p.m. marks after noon. This is an event-time phrase from the account, not a verified audio timestamp.

expressions.definition: limiting an inference to what can be understood from the filed document
expressions.source_excerpt: She's given another under 21 wristband, and it would appear at least from the filing that they do not serve her any alcoholic beverages here.
expressions.example: At least from the report, the problem appears limited.
expressions.example_cn: 至少从报告来看，问题似乎范围有限。
expressions.context_review_note: The teaching example substitutes report. Source restricts the evidentiary basis and does not prove a venue served no alcohol under all circumstances.

expressions.definition: by the stage already reached in the account
expressions.cn: 到这个时候；截至这一步
expressions.source_excerpt: By this point, Jane thinks that she's probably had like 10 drinks in the past three hours.
expressions.example: By this point, we had finished the first draft.
expressions.example_cn: 到这个时候，我们已经完成了初稿。
expressions.context_review_note: By highlights an accumulated state. Source drink count remains approximate and self-reported; no precise quantity is verified.

expressions.definition: meet someone by arrangement, usually socially
expressions.source_excerpt: To meet up with a friend.
expressions.example: I'll meet up with Maya after work.
expressions.example_cn: 我下班后会和玛雅碰头。
expressions.context_review_note: Informal arranged meeting, not necessarily first acquaintance. Source fragment states purpose and belongs with the preceding movement.

expressions.definition: as stated in the lawsuit
expressions.source_excerpt: Matthew pulls Jane off to the side and she says, according to the lawsuit, he propositioned her, asks her if she wants to have a threesome with another one of his fraternity brothers.
expressions.example: According to the lawsuit in the exercise, the payment was never received.
expressions.example_cn: 根据练习中的诉状所述，款项一直没有收到。
expressions.context_review_note: Legal-source attribution, not a finding of truth. Teaching example is fictional and unrelated to the podcast allegations.

expressions.definition: at the particular stage being discussed
expressions.cn: 在这个时候；到了这个阶段
expressions.source_excerpt: Now, according to the lawsuit, Jane at this point is so drunk, she's not even capable of consenting to any of this.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: At this point, we need to pause and check the figures.
expressions.example_cn: 到了这个阶段，我们需要暂停并核对数字。
expressions.context_review_note: At locates the stage; by this point often emphasizes what has accumulated before it. Source's capacity claim remains attributed.

expressions.definition: returns after some time or intervening events
expressions.cn: 过了一阵终于回来；后来回来
expressions.source_excerpt: And it appears that Matthew eventually comes back.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The character eventually comes back to apologize.
expressions.example_cn: 那个角色后来回来道歉。
expressions.context_review_note: Eventually is after a period, not possibly. The fictional teaching motive is not supplied to the source participant.

expressions.definition: it seems from available information that something is true
expressions.source_excerpt: And it appears that Matthew eventually comes back.
expressions.example: It appears that the appointment has been moved.
expressions.example_cn: 看来预约似乎改了时间。
expressions.context_review_note: A cautious inference, not a guarantee. Keep appears in source rather than turning the account into certainty.

expressions.definition: guides or takes her to a higher floor
expressions.source_excerpt: But Matthew just leads her upstairs, leaves her alone with one of the fraternity brothers.
expressions.example: The receptionist leads her upstairs to the meeting room.
expressions.example_cn: 接待员领她上楼去会议室。
expressions.context_review_note: Upstairs is an adverb without to. Leading a person somewhere does not itself show consent to unrelated later actions.

expressions.definition: leaves her without the speaker's or another person's company
expressions.cn: 把她独自留下；让她单独待着
expressions.source_excerpt: But Matthew just leads her upstairs, leaves her alone with one of the fraternity brothers.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: He leaves her alone to finish the puzzle.
expressions.example_cn: 他让她独自把拼图完成。
expressions.context_review_note: Source says alone with another person, meaning the first person departs, not that nobody remains. Distinguish leave someone alone meaning stop bothering them.

expressions.definition: seated or positioned on a sofa
expressions.source_excerpt: And I guess they're just like awkwardly sitting on the couch.
expressions.example: The documents are on the couch.
expressions.example_cn: 文件在沙发上。
expressions.context_review_note: Use on for a seat surface. Couch is a sofa, not coach; the phrase does not describe the uncertain plopped up wording elsewhere.

expressions.definition: a duration ranging from three minutes to five minutes
expressions.source_excerpt: But after dancing for what has been described by Matthew as three to five minutes – it's unclear how long it really was –
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The download usually takes three to five minutes.
expressions.example_cn: 下载通常需要三到五分钟。
expressions.context_review_note: To connects lower and upper bounds. Source attributes this estimate to one person and explicitly questions the actual duration.

expressions.definition: as claimed, without treating the claim itself as proof
expressions.cn: 据指称；如所指控的那样
expressions.source_excerpt: And as alleged in the lawsuit, he gets Jane and leads her to a separate room down the hall where there's a separate fraternity brother sitting on a couch, Jonathan Newell.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The damage occurred during delivery, as alleged in the complaint.
expressions.example_cn: 投诉中指称，损坏是在运输期间发生的。
expressions.context_review_note: Alleged preserves evidentiary status; it does not imply the allegation is necessarily false. The example is a generic complaint, not a podcast quotation.

expressions.definition: has not performed or experienced an activity before the reference time
expressions.cn: 此前从未做过或经历过……
expressions.source_excerpt: Jane has never done ketamine before.
expressions.example: She has never done this kind of presentation before.
expressions.example_cn: 她以前从未做过这种演示。
expressions.context_review_note: Present perfect plus never describes prior experience. Done + drug names can mean used a substance in informal speech; no drug-use instructions are supplied.

expressions.definition: in the particular respect explained by the following clause
expressions.source_excerpt: So there are people that's their room, but it's kind of a social room in the sense that nobody locks it.
expressions.example: The room is public in the sense that anyone on the team can use it.
expressions.example_cn: 从团队里任何人都能使用的意义上说，这个房间是公用的。
expressions.context_review_note: Limits what social room means: the speaker explains unlocked access, not ownership.

expressions.definition: no person locks the thing already mentioned
expressions.source_excerpt: So there are people that's their room, but it's kind of a social room in the sense that nobody locks it.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The shared cupboard is open; nobody locks it.
expressions.example_cn: 共用柜子一直开着，没有人把它锁上。
expressions.context_review_note: It refers to the room/door in source. Unlocked does not automatically mean anyone has permission for every action inside.

expressions.definition: handing something from one person to another
expressions.source_excerpt: According to the lawsuit, it seems Matthew is plopped up on the couch with Jonathan and they start passing around this plastic bag containing a white powdery substance, which Jane says they said was ketamine.
expressions.example: They were passing around a sign-up sheet.
expressions.example_cn: 他们正在传递一张报名表。
expressions.context_review_note: Separable: pass it around. Source's nested Jane says they said keeps the substance identification as a reported claim.

expressions.definition: a short time following the preceding event
expressions.source_excerpt: Soon after defendant Matthew and Jonathan began engaging in sexual acts with plaintiff all without her consent.
expressions.example: Soon after the meeting, she sent a summary.
expressions.example_cn: 会议结束不久，她就发了一份摘要。
expressions.context_review_note: Relative timing, not an exact interval. Source introduces alleged acts and does not supply a precise duration.

expressions.definition: without her freely given agreement or permission
expressions.source_excerpt: Soon after defendant Matthew and Jonathan began engaging in sexual acts with plaintiff all without her consent.
expressions.example: The photo was shared without her consent.
expressions.example_cn: 照片未经她同意就被分享了。
expressions.context_review_note: Consent is agreement, not mere presence or failure to speak. Source explicitly alleges absence of consent; that attribution is retained.

expressions.definition: following the order presented in an account
expressions.source_excerpt: Okay, perhaps this is like the first decent individual that's going to be uncovered according to the sequence of events in this lawsuit, right?
expressions.example: According to the sequence in the report, testing came before approval.
expressions.example_cn: 按照报告中的顺序，测试发生在批准之前。
expressions.context_review_note: Usually complete with of events or an identified account. The source's temporary hope about a person's motives is not established by event order.

expressions.definition: at an unspecified time or stage
expressions.cn: 在某个时候；到了某个阶段
expressions.source_excerpt: But at some point the lawsuit states that Matthew could no longer maintain an erection.
expressions.example: At some point, we'll need to review the plan.
expressions.example_cn: 到了某个阶段，我们需要重新审视计划。
expressions.context_review_note: Deliberately leaves the time unspecified; no exact audio timing or event time may be inferred.

expressions.definition: begins sleeping
expressions.source_excerpt: He just hops onto one of the three beds and he falls asleep.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The child falls asleep during the ride.
expressions.example_cn: 孩子在乘车途中睡着了。
expressions.context_review_note: Fall asleep is entering sleep; be asleep is the state. Source does not establish why the person slept.

expressions.definition: continues making attempts to do something
expressions.source_excerpt: Meanwhile, Jonathan keeps, according to the lawsuit, keeps trying to reach for her private parts down there.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: She keeps trying to open the old file.
expressions.example_cn: 她一直试图打开那个旧文件。
expressions.context_review_note: Keep + -ing followed by try to + base verb. Repeated attempts do not imply success; source alleges continued unwanted attempts.

expressions.definition: at the same time as another event
expressions.source_excerpt: Meanwhile, Jonathan keeps, according to the lawsuit, keeps trying to reach for her private parts down there.
expressions.example: I prepared the slides; meanwhile, my colleague checked the data.
expressions.example_cn: 我准备幻灯片，与此同时，同事核对数据。
expressions.context_review_note: Connects concurrent strands, not necessarily a causal relationship. Source's according to the lawsuit still scopes the following allegation.

expressions.definition: arrive or come over, in informal slang
expressions.source_excerpt: And then PU typically stands for pull up.
expressions.example: You can pull up around eight if you're free.
expressions.example_cn: 如果有空，你可以八点左右过来。
expressions.context_review_note: PU is interpreted by the narrator as pull up but immediately qualified in 543. Do not turn that expansion into a verified message transcription.

expressions.definition: go to see whether someone is safe or doing well
expressions.source_excerpt: Surely one of them must go check up on the individual to see if they're okay, because this is not a normal message that can go out.
expressions.example: I'll go check up on our neighbor after the storm.
expressions.example_cn: 暴风雨后，我会去看看邻居是否安好。
expressions.context_review_note: Welfare-check sense here; check up on can elsewhere imply monitoring behavior. Source expresses an expectation, not evidence anyone performed the check.

expressions.definition: in a different room from the one being discussed
expressions.source_excerpt: We're going to get into Scott K. later, but he later tells the school that he was in a separate room with a bunch of his friends.
expressions.example: The interviews took place in a separate room.
expressions.example_cn: 面试在另一间房里进行。
expressions.context_review_note: Separate identifies a different space; the source is a person's reported account of location, not an independently established alibi.

expressions.definition: a request to clarify an intended meaning
expressions.cn: 你是什么意思；你具体指什么
expressions.source_excerpt: Maybe he's like, what do you mean free?
expressions.example: What do you mean by urgent?
expressions.example_cn: 你说的紧急，具体是什么意思？
expressions.context_review_note: Use by before the term being questioned. Source imagines a possible question rather than confirming it was asked.

expressions.definition: pass, when referring to time
expressions.source_excerpt: And then 10 minutes go by him and his other friend, his buddy, the other Scott.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: Ten minutes went by before anyone replied.
expressions.example_cn: 过了十分钟才有人回复。
expressions.context_review_note: Time sense; not pass a place or use a particular name.

expressions.definition: I may be perceiving or interpreting a signal
expressions.cn: 我可能感受到或理解出……
expressions.source_excerpt: I could be picking up the wrong things.
expressions.example: I could be picking up the wrong tone from this email.
expressions.example_cn: 我可能误解了这封邮件的语气。
expressions.context_review_note: Could admits possible error; pick up is perceive here, not physically collect. The wrong things in source concerns interpretation, not proven events.

expressions.definition: I have not seen him again after the earlier event or time
expressions.cn: 从那以后我就没见过他
expressions.source_excerpt: However, when I'm reading this, I'm reading this as like, no, this must be legit because my buddy just went in there and he, I haven't seen him since.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: He left on Monday, and I haven't seen him since.
expressions.example_cn: 他周一离开后，我就没再见过他。
expressions.context_review_note: Since can stand alone when the starting event is clear. Not seeing someone does not establish where they went or what they did.

expressions.definition: suddenly or unexpectedly
expressions.source_excerpt: And like Diego, maybe that's where Diego went because Diego left out of nowhere.
expressions.example: The question came out of nowhere.
expressions.example_cn: 那个问题来得很突然。
expressions.context_review_note: Figurative surprise; source's left out of nowhere means departure felt sudden, not that a person had no location of origin.

expressions.definition: this expresses my personal judgment rather than confirmed knowledge
expressions.source_excerpt: Like, okay, if I read it, this is my opinion because I don't know what's going on in Scott K's mind or what Scott K did or didn't do.
expressions.example: This is my opinion, but the shorter version is clearer.
expressions.example_cn: 这是我的个人看法，不过短一点的版本更清楚。
expressions.context_review_note: Marks epistemic scope; it does not make factual allegations immune from verification. Source explicitly lacks knowledge of another person's mind.

expressions.definition: what is happening or causing the current situation
expressions.cn: 发生什么事了；是什么情况
expressions.source_excerpt: They pull up their phones and they're like, oh, my God, the Snapchat, like what's going on?
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: What's going on with the booking system?
expressions.example_cn: 预订系统是什么情况？
expressions.context_review_note: What's = what is. Go on means happen here, not continue walking; source expresses surprise about the messages.

expressions.definition: the perspective of the person experiencing or describing events directly
expressions.source_excerpt: So scott k says the alumni shit is not a bit first person pov not a bit um
expressions.example: The game uses a first-person POV.
expressions.example_cn: 这款游戏采用第一人称视角。
expressions.context_review_note: POV is point of view, read as letters. A chat's claim of firsthand perspective is not independent proof of observation.

expressions.definition: honestly; not lying, in very informal slang
expressions.source_excerpt: Yeah, like this is like no cap.
expressions.example: That was the best meal I've had all week, no cap.
expressions.example_cn: 那是我这周吃过最好的一顿，真的不骗你。
expressions.context_review_note: Register is internet/youth slang, not formal testimony or proof of accuracy.

expressions.definition: not a joke or a staged comic routine, in this chat context
expressions.source_excerpt: So scott k says the alumni shit is not a bit first person pov not a bit um
expressions.example: That wasn't a bit; I really forgot my own address.
expressions.example_cn: 那不是我在搞笑；我真的忘了自己的地址。
expressions.context_review_note: Bit here is a comedy routine, not the ordinary not a bit meaning not at all. The claim itself is not verified.

expressions.definition: this is asserted to be real rather than invented or counterfeit
expressions.source_excerpt: This is not fake.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: The character insists, 'This is not fake.'
expressions.example_cn: 那个角色坚持说：“这不是假的。”
expressions.context_review_note: An authenticity claim, not its verification. Source paraphrases the chat's stance rather than proving the events.

expressions.definition: during the particular past or narrated moment being discussed
expressions.source_excerpt: At the time that it's happening.
expressions.example: I didn't understand the instructions at the time.
expressions.example_cn: 我当时没理解那些说明。
expressions.context_review_note: Needs a contextual time reference; source attaches the lack of knowledge to when messages were sent, not forever afterward.

expressions.definition: learn how to navigate the demands and routines of college life
expressions.source_excerpt: This is another undergraduate student who's also just trying to figure out college.
expressions.example: She's still trying to figure out college and living away from home.
expressions.example_cn: 她还在摸索如何适应大学生活和离家独立生活。
expressions.context_review_note: College is the experience to navigate, not a puzzle with one answer. Informal broad object after figure out; transferable to figure out a new job.

expressions.definition: be selected for paid employment
expressions.source_excerpt: They just get hired.
expressions.example: He hopes to get hired by a local company.
expressions.example_cn: 他希望被一家本地公司聘用。
expressions.context_review_note: Conversational get-passive; getting hired is not the same as joining an organization as a student member.

expressions.definition: begin moving rhythmically to music
expressions.source_excerpt: And Jane and Matthew, they start dancing on the main room together.
expressions.example: They start dancing when the music begins.
expressions.example_cn: 音乐一响，他们就开始跳舞。
expressions.context_review_note: Start + -ing or start to dance. Source has on the main room, an unusual preposition left unchanged; dancing is not consent to other acts.

expressions.definition: being seated on a sofa
expressions.source_excerpt: And I guess they're just like awkwardly sitting on the couch.
expressions.example: We were sitting on the couch discussing our plans.
expressions.example_cn: 我们坐在沙发上讨论计划。
expressions.context_review_note: Sit doubles t before -ing. Source's I guess marks a conjectural description, not verified observation.

expressions.text: pulls Jane off to the side
expressions.definition: draws Jane away from the main group to one side
expressions.source_excerpt: Matthew pulls Jane off to the side and she says, according to the lawsuit, he propositioned her, asks her if she wants to have a threesome with another one of his fraternity brothers.
expressions.example: She pulls her colleague off to the side for a quick question.
expressions.example_cn: 她把同事拉到一旁，简短地问了个问题。
expressions.context_review_note: Pull someone off to the side can describe steering someone aside; the phrase alone does not settle the amount of force. Names in the source remain unchanged.

expressions.definition: a different room apart from the one previously mentioned

expressions.definition: no memory of a particular event

expressions.definition: made only a very small amount of progress through something large
expressions.source_excerpt: So just to quickly emphasize the potential depravity, we've barely made a dent in Jane Doe's lawsuit.

expressions.definition: at the opposite side of a space or object

expressions.context_review_note: Needs a reference space if not already clear. Source means across the room, not an opposing opinion or an afterlife euphemism.

expressions.definition: she has the subjective impression that something is so
expressions.source_excerpt: Jane says that her phone is on the other side of the room and she feels like there's no way for her to escape this room.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.definition: surrounding information that helps someone infer a meaning or fact
expressions.source_excerpt: But you can read the lawsuit and kind of get context clues.

expressions.definition: use surrounding details to infer information

expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.example_cn: 我们可以从上一段寻找上下文线索。

expressions.definition: I cannot state something without doubt

expressions.example: I cannot say with certainty when the parcel will arrive.
expressions.example_cn: 我无法确定包裹什么时候到。
expressions.context_review_note: A formal confidence disclaimer, not a statement that no evidence exists. Source does not identify which person uses the pseudonym.

expressions.definition: relatively few people
expressions.source_excerpt: And that one you're saying not a lot of people are talking about the details, right?
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认
expressions.example: Not a lot of people attended the early session.
expressions.example_cn: 参加早场活动的人不多。
expressions.context_review_note: Few, not none. Source concerns discussion of a lawsuit, not a measured audience count.

expressions.definition: without doubt or hesitation about truth
expressions.source_excerpt: Though I cannot say with certainty, legally speaking, which one it is.
expressions.example: We can't predict the result with certainty.
expressions.example_cn: 我们无法确定地预测结果。
expressions.context_review_note: Usually modifies know, say or predict. Source negative cannot limits confidence rather than declaring a fact.

expressions.definition: obtaining something that may be difficult to access
expressions.source_excerpt: So I do know that a lot of these big – I think ABC News has been getting their hands on – I don't know if they got the whole Title IX investigation, which that is not publicly available and probably will never be publicly available.
expressions.example: Reporters were getting their hands on previously unavailable records.
expressions.example_cn: 记者们正在设法拿到此前无法获取的记录。

expressions.definition: not accessible to the public
expressions.cn: 不对公众开放；无法公开获取
expressions.source_excerpt: So I do know that a lot of these big – I think ABC News has been getting their hands on – I don't know if they got the whole Title IX investigation, which that is not publicly available and probably will never be publicly available.

expressions.definition: accessible to members of the public
expressions.source_excerpt: So I do know that a lot of these big – I think ABC News has been getting their hands on – I don't know if they got the whole Title IX investigation, which that is not publicly available and probably will never be publicly available.
expressions.example: We used publicly available data for the analysis.

expressions.definition: the result of a process or event
expressions.source_excerpt: And then shortly after, one of the John Doe's sued Cornell as well because they didn't like the outcome.

expressions.definition: a lawsuit document described as about one hundred pages long
expressions.cn: 一份约一百页的诉讼文书
expressions.source_excerpt: So it's like a hundred page lawsuit and there's just a lot of, a lot of information in there that we've pieced together and tried to cross.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.context_review_note: Edited form uses hundred-page before the noun and page stays singular. Source like makes the length approximate; a lawsuit itself is a proceeding, with document implied here.

expressions.definition: comparing related information across sources or entries
expressions.source_excerpt: We're going to get into all the cross-referencing of who is who because

expressions.example_cn: 我们正在对照核查两份报告中的日期。

expressions.definition: discuss in detail the comparisons among the sources
expressions.cn: 详细讲解各项交叉核对
expressions.source_excerpt: We're going to get into all the cross-referencing of who is who because

expressions.example_cn: 概述之后，我们会详细讲解各项交叉核对。

expressions.definition: it is a difficult or troublesome task or situation
expressions.cn: 这事很麻烦；很让人头疼
expressions.source_excerpt: It's a headache.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.definition: it does not meet even the description of an office

expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.definition: immediately beside the room already mentioned

expressions.definition: by the stage already reached in the account

expressions.definition: feeling extremely upset or stunned after a disturbing event
expressions.cn: 处于震惊、惊魂未定的状态

expressions.context_review_note: Emotional description in this account, not a medical diagnosis of circulatory shock.

expressions.definition: because of feeling afraid
expressions.source_excerpt: She says that she notices this large bruise on her butt area and out of fear, she started taking, I guess out of fear, she started taking UTI medication as a preemptive measure.
expressions.grammatical_pattern: 原文语境已定位；汉语释义须结合整句确认

expressions.example_cn: 他因为害怕冲突而避开了那次谈话。

expressions.definition: during the particular period being discussed
expressions.source_excerpt: So this is before he becomes, he was an interim president at the time.
expressions.example: She was working abroad at the time.
expressions.example_cn: 她当时在国外工作。
expressions.context_review_note: Recording-relative past period, not the review date. Source's unfinished before he becomes clause remains unchanged.

expressions.definition: cannot avoid doing or thinking something
expressions.source_excerpt: And there is a very general vagueness to the statement that I can't help but think it's very intentional, the timing and the vagueness.

expressions.definition: strongly believe something is unlikely

expressions.definition: despite what has just been said

expressions.definition: leaves school before completing the course of study

expressions.definition: during the latter of two parts

expressions.definition: become well or regain stability after harm or difficulty

expressions.example_cn: 团队需要时间从挫折中恢复过来。
expressions.context_review_note: Recover from + difficulty differs from recover a lost file. Source expresses a wish and difficulty, not a promised treatment result.

expressions.text: on the other side of the room

expressions.text: there's no way for her to

expressions.example_cn: 没有访问权限，她无法上传它。

expressions.definition: more information about that topic will follow

expressions.definition: I do not remember the event being discussed

expressions.definition: with little noise or, figuratively, little publicity

expressions.definition: for many people in the group being discussed

expressions.definition: an official report of a grievance or alleged wrongdoing

expressions.definition: given permission to come back

expressions.definition: three academic terms in a semester-based calendar

expressions.definition: immediately taken up for reporting or wider attention

expressions.definition: the latter of two parts

expressions.definition: to move backward, especially in a vehicle

expressions.example: Could you back up a little?
expressions.example_cn: 你能稍微往后退一点吗？

expressions.definition: having responsibility for causing or dealing with something
expressions.example: Who is responsible for checking the report?
expressions.example_cn: 谁负责检查这份报告？
expressions.source_excerpt: They were the ones responsible for this event.
expressions.context_review_note: Responsibility for the event, not necessarily legal guilt.

expressions.definition: a very confused or badly handled situation, expressed with strong profanity
expressions.example: The schedule was a complete mess.
expressions.example_cn: 日程安排乱成了一团。
expressions.source_excerpt: It was a fucking mess.
expressions.context_review_note: Receptive listening target; teaching example deliberately uses the neutral a complete mess. Avoid the source wording in polite/workplace conversation.

expressions.definition: additional questions asked after an initial answer
expressions.example: I have two follow-up questions about your proposal.
expressions.example_cn: 关于你的提议，我还有两个问题想追问。
expressions.source_excerpt: They're asking him follow-up questions.
expressions.context_review_note: Hyphenated adjective follow-up; verb follow up is written separately.

expressions.definition: the side of a vehicle where the driver sits
expressions.example: The scratch is on the driver's side.
expressions.example_cn: 划痕在驾驶员一侧。
expressions.source_excerpt: He gets in the driver's side
expressions.context_review_note: Get in means enter the vehicle; paragraph ends without specifying door, so none is added to the quote.

expressions.definition: physical injury to a person
expressions.example: The warning mentioned a risk of bodily harm.
expressions.example_cn: 警告提到了人身伤害的风险。
expressions.source_excerpt: It's not like the students created some sort of scary human chain where they're just like threatening bodily harm.
expressions.context_review_note: Here threatening bodily harm is within a comparison the narrator rejects, not a claim that this happened.

expressions.definition: people standing in a linked line, often as a barrier
expressions.example: The volunteers formed a human chain.
expressions.example_cn: 志愿者们排成了一道人链。
expressions.source_excerpt: It's not like the students created some sort of scary human chain where they're just like threatening bodily harm.
expressions.context_review_note: The narrator says it was not like this threatening scenario.

expressions.definition: eventually obtain or experience something as an outcome
expressions.example: Did you end up getting the job?
expressions.example_cn: 你最后得到那份工作了吗？
expressions.source_excerpt: The student who had his foot allegedly run over, he did end up getting his degree the month after the incident.
expressions.context_review_note: Did end up adds emphasis; getting his degree means graduating.

expressions.definition: moving rather than stationary
expressions.example: Keep the doors closed while the vehicle is in motion.
expressions.example_cn: 车辆行驶时请保持车门关闭。
expressions.source_excerpt: And the notice of the ban reads, quote, while in the day hall parking lot, you restricted a motor vehicle's ability to maneuver while it was in motion.
expressions.context_review_note: Formal wording from the notice, paired with restrict a vehicle's ability to move.

expressions.definition: more action or effort than a situation reasonably needs
expressions.example: Three meetings for this small change would be overkill.
expressions.example_cn: 为这个小改动开三次会未免小题大做。
expressions.source_excerpt: Which, like, all of this seems so overkill.
expressions.context_review_note: Evaluative figurative noun, not killing; sentence expresses the narrator's judgment.

expressions.definition: progressing toward a result or destination
expressions.example: They are on their way to finishing the project.
expressions.example_cn: 他们快要完成这个项目了。
expressions.source_excerpt: They're on their way to graduating.
expressions.context_review_note: To is a preposition followed by graduating/finishing, not an infinitive marker.

expressions.definition: joining a discussion by expressing an opinion
expressions.example: Several colleagues are weighing in on the proposal.
expressions.example_cn: 几位同事正在就这项提议发表看法。
expressions.source_excerpt: Yeah, Trump is weighing in, stating that the accused aren't going to get a fair shake if a certain prosecutor is investigating the case.
expressions.context_review_note: Not body weight; weighing in on a topic is the reusable pattern.

expressions.definition: not at all, used for strong emphasis
expressions.example: The delay did not bother her, not even in the slightest.
expressions.example_cn: 延误丝毫没有让她烦心。
expressions.source_excerpt: But that will not, not even in the slightest, be the worst investigation and scandal that Cornell University will be caught up in in this year.
expressions.context_review_note: Parenthetical emphasis interrupts will not ... be; no new proposition is inserted.

expressions.definition: to take action or accept responsibility when needed
expressions.example: Someone needs to step up and organize the meeting.
expressions.example_cn: 需要有人站出来组织会议。
expressions.source_excerpt: The U.S. Marine Corps is having to step up to tell the Internet, wait, you've got the wrong guy like that.
expressions.context_review_note: Here the organization intervenes to correct mistaken identity, not to step onto a platform.

expressions.definition: money or support available if financial difficulties arise
expressions.example: Her savings gave her a financial safety net.
expressions.example_cn: 她的积蓄给她提供了经济保障。
expressions.source_excerpt: She does not have a personal GoFundMe, but there is an additional GoFundMe that she has endorsed which supports other survivors who don't have the financial safety net Jane Doe has.
expressions.context_review_note: Metaphorical net; not a literal net or the fundraiser itself.

expressions.definition: indirect consequences that spread beyond an initial event
expressions.example: The closure had ripple effects on nearby shops.
expressions.example_cn: 这次停业给附近商店带来了连锁影响。
expressions.source_excerpt: This episode discusses an alleged sexual assault, including drug and alcohol usage, potential coercion, as well as the greater ripple effects that have resulted from this case.
expressions.context_review_note: Effects may be positive or negative, as the following paragraph states.

expressions.definition: to look after your own well-being
expressions.example: Take care of yourself and rest when you need to.
expressions.example_cn: 照顾好自己，需要时就休息。
expressions.source_excerpt: If you are a survivor or you find this subject hard to hear, please take care of yourself.
expressions.context_review_note: Self-care advice in a content warning, not medical instructions.

expressions.definition: cannot emphasize something more strongly
expressions.example: I cannot stress enough how important preparation is.
expressions.example_cn: 准备工作有多重要，我再怎么强调都不为过。
expressions.source_excerpt: And I also cannot stress enough, this case is currently ongoing.
expressions.context_review_note: Stress means emphasize, not feel anxious.

expressions.definition: not an assessment, as the first part of a neither...nor comparison
expressions.example: This is neither a judgment of your work nor a criticism of your effort.
expressions.example_cn: 这既不是对你工作的评判，也不是对你努力的批评。
expressions.source_excerpt: And us having to state that is neither a judgment of the case, nor is it a judgment of Jane Doe's credibility, nor is it a judgment of the accused credibility.
expressions.context_review_note: Teach neither A nor B; the original extends the pattern with another nor.

expressions.definition: continue giving you new information
expressions.cn: 随时向你们通报最新情况
expressions.example: We will keep you guys updated as the plan develops.
expressions.example_cn: 随着计划推进，我们会随时向大家通报最新情况。
expressions.source_excerpt: If there are any massive developments or changes, we will do our best to keep you guys updated.
expressions.context_review_note: Informal you guys; neutral alternative keep you updated.

expressions.definition: appearing or being created in increasing numbers
expressions.example: New apps seem to be spawning every week.
expressions.example_cn: 新应用似乎每周都在不断冒出来。
expressions.source_excerpt: It just feels like new lawyers are spawning every week to do an interview with ABC News.
expressions.context_review_note: Gaming-like metaphor for lawyers appearing, not literal reproduction.

expressions.definition: provide insurance protection for you
expressions.example: Check whether the policy will cover you abroad.
expressions.example_cn: 查一下这份保单是否为你提供境外保障。
expressions.source_excerpt: We will cover you.
expressions.context_review_note: Connect cover a person with cover a cost; narrator contrasts selling policies with paying claims.

expressions.definition: to establish or start an organization or arrangement
expressions.example: They set up a small company together.
expressions.example_cn: 他们一起创办了一家小公司。
expressions.source_excerpt: They have set up their own insurance companies.
expressions.context_review_note: Establishing a company, not framing someone or physically arranging equipment.

expressions.definition: joined forces or gathered for a shared purpose
expressions.example: Several local groups came together to organize the event.
expressions.example_cn: 几个本地团体联合起来组织了这场活动。
expressions.source_excerpt: Some big fraternities even came together to create their own insurance company.
expressions.context_review_note: Organizations cooperating, not literal physical collision.

expressions.definition: well-known or influential people or organizations in a field
expressions.example: Several big names in the industry attended.
expressions.example_cn: 几位业内知名人士出席了。
expressions.source_excerpt: There's some really big ones, like big names in the industry that all of the chapter heads, the national heads of these organizations fucking hate these lawyers.
expressions.context_review_note: Reputation and prominence, not long names or body size.

expressions.definition: to accept responsibility for a task or case
expressions.example: Our team cannot take on another project this month.
expressions.example_cn: 我们团队这个月无法再接一个项目。
expressions.source_excerpt: It's like a whole ecosphere of lawyers who only take on fraternity cases.
expressions.context_review_note: Lawyers accepting cases, not putting on clothing or confronting an opponent.

expressions.definition: being discussed or referred to
expressions.example: The document in question was sent yesterday.
expressions.example_cn: 所说的那份文件是昨天发送的。
expressions.source_excerpt: The patient in question denies that this ever happened
expressions.context_review_note: Patient in question identifies the patient under discussion; not a patient asking a question.

expressions.definition: no memory of something
expressions.example: I have no recollection of signing that form.
expressions.example_cn: 我完全不记得签过那张表。
expressions.source_excerpt: However police found circumstantial evidence in the fraternity house including evidence that the patient may have lost control of his bowels in the process and defecated on himself which he also has no recollection of
expressions.context_review_note: Of can be followed by a noun or -ing; attributed lack of memory is not independent confirmation of an event.

expressions.definition: to explain something in less complicated words
expressions.example: To put it simply, we need more time.
expressions.example_cn: 简单地说，我们需要更多时间。
expressions.source_excerpt: And it's hard to gauge how much is going up the butt, to put it simply.
expressions.context_review_note: Put means express; transferable to ordinary explanations without reproducing the medical-risk context.

expressions.definition: developed badly or failed to happen as intended
expressions.cn: 出了岔子；发生了不良后果
expressions.example: The trip had gone wrong before we even left town.
expressions.example_cn: 我们还没离开城镇，这趟旅行就已经出了岔子。
expressions.source_excerpt: I mean, there are like a lot of branding gone wrong where plaintiffs need skin grafts in extreme cases because they were branded by some sort of hot iron tool.
expressions.context_review_note: Postmodifier branding gone wrong; teaching example transfers the outcome meaning.

expressions.definition: investigating or trying to learn more about something
expressions.example: We are looking into the cause of the delay.
expressions.example_cn: 我们正在调查延误的原因。
expressions.source_excerpt: When I was looking into this, I was very confused.
expressions.context_review_note: Not physically looking inside a container.

expressions.definition: much more frequently
expressions.example: We use this room way more often now.
expressions.example_cn: 我们现在使用这个房间的频率高多了。
expressions.source_excerpt: It happens way more often than I ever imagined.
expressions.context_review_note: Way is an informal degree intensifier, not a path.

expressions.definition: the financial result or practical financial interest
expressions.example: The extra costs will affect our bottom line.
expressions.example_cn: 这些额外成本会影响我们的财务结果。
expressions.source_excerpt: And also on top of that, there is a bottom line incentive.
expressions.context_review_note: In bottom line incentive, means financial motive rather than the lowest printed line or personal boundary.

expressions.definition: schools or universities that people formerly attended
expressions.example: The graduates donated books to their alma maters.
expressions.example_cn: 毕业生们向各自的母校捐赠了书籍。
expressions.source_excerpt: But also alumni who are part of Greek life seem to, at least according to one research done, seem more financially generous to their alma maters later in life if they were part of Greek life.
expressions.context_review_note: Latin-derived fixed expression; alumni is people, alma maters is their former institutions.

expressions.definition: being raised or appearing in discussion
expressions.example: The same question keeps coming up in meetings.
expressions.example_cn: 同一个问题在会议中不断被提出。
expressions.source_excerpt: But I guess the question that's been coming up more recently is, is it really fucking worth it?
expressions.context_review_note: Question emerging in discussion, not an upcoming physical movement.

expressions.definition: almost or approximately a stated number
expressions.example: Close to fifty people attended.
expressions.example_cn: 将近五十人出席了。
expressions.source_excerpt: It's said that they have close to 50,000 living members.
expressions.context_review_note: Numerical approximation, not physical proximity.

expressions.definition: screamed extremely loudly, usually in distress or protest
expressions.example: He screamed bloody murder when he saw the spider.
expressions.example_cn: 他看到蜘蛛时吓得大声尖叫。
expressions.source_excerpt: Smeared all over his genitals but he did not consent to anyone touching him or inflicting this amount of pain he says i screamed bloody murder
expressions.context_review_note: Informal idiom; does not mean that a murder actually occurred. Source is an attributed report of distress.

expressions.definition: remove something from a surface using washing
expressions.example: Wash off the mud before you come inside.
expressions.example_cn: 进屋前先把泥洗掉。
expressions.source_excerpt: A few minutes later i was given a half gallon of milk to wash off my spicy junk
expressions.context_review_note: Phrasal verb taught with a neutral example; original mention of milk is not presented as treatment advice.

expressions.definition: present addiction as though it were courage or something admirable
expressions.example: The article criticized attempts to frame addiction as valor.
expressions.example_cn: 文章批评了把成瘾包装成勇气的做法。
expressions.source_excerpt: Along with the social license to frame addiction as valor and sexual conquest as glory.
expressions.context_review_note: Reusable frame A as B means portray A as B; valor means courage. This is a critical description, not praise.

expressions.definition: food remaining after a meal or use
expressions.example: Put the leftover food in a container.
expressions.example_cn: 把剩下的食物装进容器里。
expressions.source_excerpt: And now in one of the now-vacant rooms, a very important room for this case, one video shows someone walking through this empty room and there's garbage, leftover food everywhere, discarded furniture.
expressions.context_review_note: Leftover modifies food; leftovers can stand alone as a plural noun.

expressions.definition: used to make a previous statement more precise
expressions.example: We waited an hour—sixty-five minutes, to be exact.
expressions.example_cn: 我们等了一个小时，确切地说是六十五分钟。
expressions.source_excerpt: There is an arrest made for ketamine at a fraternity at Chi Phi, to be exact, a drug related arrest at the same exact house.
expressions.context_review_note: Specifies which house, not proof of the precise offense.

expressions.definition: a person's promise can be trusted as a binding commitment
expressions.example: He believes his word is his bond and keeps his promises.
expressions.example_cn: 他相信应当一诺千金，并信守承诺。
expressions.source_excerpt: A man's word is his bond.
expressions.context_review_note: Fixed proverb; bond means binding promise, not a financial security. Source uses a traditional masculine formulation.

expressions.definition: stops functioning or collapses, literally or figuratively
expressions.example: The plan falls apart if nobody confirms the booking.
expressions.example_cn: 如果没人确认预订，计划就会泡汤。
expressions.source_excerpt: She joins Cornell, joins a sorority, and all of this falls apart her sophomore year.
expressions.context_review_note: Figurative disruption of the person's situation; does not mean literal bodily disintegration.

expressions.definition: received news coverage across the country
expressions.example: The discovery made national news.
expressions.example_cn: 这一发现成为了全国性新闻。
expressions.source_excerpt: There was an entire Title IX investigation at Cornell but it never made national news
